sentences.en: A facet of genius is the ability to provoke scandals.
sentences.zh: 天才的一个方面是能够激起丑闻的能力。

sentences.en: Antigens are substances capable of provoking the formation of antibodies.
sentences.zh: 抗原是一种能促使抗体形成的物质。

sentences.en: Provoking Fadil was poking a stick at an angry bull.
sentences.zh: 挑衅法迪尔就像在激怒一头愤怒的公牛。

senses.zh: 激怒，惹恼；引起，激起；刺激，诱导
